# Experimental trial shift handoff

The outgoing studio shift identifies the trial and names the unresolved question on the handoff ledger. The incoming shift checks the specimen envelope against its separate contents checklist, repeats the coded material identity back from its card, and records receipt or an explicit missing-item exception.

Keep the experimental label on the specimen and leave the unresolved question open until a later observation answers it. A receipt proves custody was recorded, not that the trial succeeded. The envelope sheet defines the package contents and the trial-code glossary defines how to read material identity; this process does not duplicate either.
